title: Contract Intelligence — Operations
description: System, Docker, OCR, cost and service health. Provisioned from git (read-only).

panels.title: OCR API (AI1 worker)
panels.description: Down: metrics endpoint not scraped. Degraded: 20%+ of OCR commands failed in the last 15 min.

panels.title: Backend API
panels.description: Down: metrics endpoint not scraped. Degraded: 5%+ of requests answered 5xx in the last 5 min.

panels.title: Prometheus
panels.description: Prometheus scraping itself.

panels.title: Grafana
panels.description: Prometheus scraping Grafana's /metrics.

panels.title: Node Exporter
panels.description: Host metrics exporter.

panels.title: cAdvisor
panels.description: Container metrics exporter.

panels.title: Disk Usage
panels.description: Fullest real filesystem on the host.

panels.title: Load Average
panels.description: Run-queue length; compare with the number of CPU cores.

panels.title: Disk Usage
panels.description: Per block device (one device can be mounted at several paths).

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Host interfaces, from cAdvisor's root cgroup: node-exporter runs in a bridge network (no host port), so its own counters would only show its container.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: 100% = one full CPU core.

panels.title: Container status (seconds since last seen)
panels.description: One row per container name, from its most recently seen instance: a recreated container does not leave its old IDs behind as Stopped. Running: seen by cAdvisor in the last minute. Stopped: red, seen within the last hour only.

panels.title: Container restarts (last 1h)
panels.description: Start time changed = restarted in place. A container recreated by compose gets a new id and shows as a new row.

panels.title: OCR Requests
panels.description: OCR commands finished in the time range.

panels.title: Fallback Rate
panels.description: Pages read by the fallback reader (GPT) because Mistral failed or returned nothing.

panels.title: HITL Rate
panels.description: Pages flagged for human review (needs_review / possible duplicate).

panels.title: P50 Latency
panels.description: Per OCR command, over the time range.

panels.title: OCR latency
panels.description: Rolling 30 min window.

panels.title: Backend API requests
panels.description: Excludes the /grafana proxy itself.

panels.title: Backend API P95 latency (top routes)
panels.description: SSE event streams excluded (long-lived by design).

panels.title: Total OCR Cost
panels.description: Same per-call figures Langfuse records as cost_details; per-document detail lives in Langfuse.

options.content: Per-document traces (model, latency, cost, errors, fallback, pages) stay in **Langfuse Cloud**. This dashboard only holds aggregates, with no contract content, file names or user data.
